tha-ap25:1.1: candavatiyā → bandhumatiyā (bj: sī.selu, aṭṭhakathā) | candavatiyā → bandhumatiyā (cck: aṭṭha.)
tha-ap25:1.2: mātuupaṭṭhāko ahuṁ → mātupaṭṭhānako ahaṁ (sya-all) | mātuupaṭṭhāko → mātupaṭṭhāyako (cck: sī.); mātupaṭṭhānako (cck: syā.)
tha-ap25:3.1: mahandhakārapihitā → tamandhakārapihitā (bj, sya-all) | tamandhakārapihitā → mahandhakārapihitā (bj note) | Mahandhakārapihitā → tamandhakārapihitā (cck: syā.)
tha-ap25:3.3: bhaye → bhave (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu) | bhave → bhaye (cck: sī.)
tha-ap25:4.2: dāni sāsanaṁ → jinasāsanaṁ (bj, pts) | dippati → dippeti (sya-all) | dippati → dibbati (cck: ka.) | dippati → jinasāsanaṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap25:4.4: puññakāmena → puññakammena (bj, pts) | puññakammena → puññakāmena (bj: sī.selu)
tha-ap25:5.4: paṭimokkhāmi → paṭimukkhāmi (sya-all); parimokkhāmi (pts) | paṭimokkhāmi → pari (bj: PTS)
tha-ap25:7.3: saraṇagamanaṁ → saraṇāgamanaṁ (bj, sya-all) | saraṇagamanaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ → saraṇāgamaṇaṁ paripuṇṇam (pts)
tha-ap25:8.1: vattamānamhi saraṇaṁ taṁ → vattamāṇamhi saraṇan tam (pts)
tha-ap25:8.4: agacchahaṁ → agañchahaṁ (sya-all) | agacchahaṁ devalokagato → agaṁch ahaṁ devaloke gato (pts)
tha-ap25:9.3: upagacchāmi → upapajjāmi (bj: machasaṁ, PTS, sī.selu) | desaṁ → yaṁ yaṁ desaṁ (cck: syā.) | upapajjāmi → upagacchāmi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap25:11.4: abbhuggato mamaṁ asītikkhattu → accuggato mama asītikkhattuṁ (bj, sya-all) | abbhuggato → accuggato (pts) | accuggato → abbhuggato (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap25:12.2: devarajjamakārayiṁ dibbasukhaṁ → devarajjam akārayiṁ dibbaṁ sukhaṁ (pts)
tha-ap25:14.1: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all)
tha-ap25:15.3: hasakhiḍḍasamaṅgīhaṁ → hāsakhiḍḍhāsamaṁgīhaṁ (bj); sāyaṁ khiddāsamaṅgīhaṁ (sya-all); sahassakhiḍḍasamaṅgī haṁ (pts) | hāsakhiḍḍhāsamaṁgīhaṁ → sahasā khiḍḍa (bj: sī.selu, PTS) | Hasakhiḍḍasamaṅgīhaṁ → sāhaṁ khiḍḍasamaṅgī (cck: syā.)
tha-ap25:18.1: sattame vasse arahattamapāpuṇiṁ → sattavassena arahattaṁ apāpuṇiṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap25:19.2: agacchahaṁ → agacchihaṁ (bj); agañch ahaṁ (pts) | agacchahaṁ tato → agañchahaṁ tāva (sya-all)
tha-ap25:21.3: ahaṁ → atthaṁ (sya-all, pts) | ahaṁ → atthaṁ (bj: sī.selu) | Ahaṁ → atthaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap25:21.4: sāmaṁ diṭṭhaṁ padaṁ mama → samaṁ diṭṭham idaṁ mamaṁ (pts) | padaṁ → diṭṭhamidaṁ (bj: PTS); diṭṭhapadaṁ (bj: sī.selu)
tha-ap25:24.2: gopiya → gopaya (pts) | gopiya → gopaya (bj: sī.selu, PTS)
tha-ap25:25.1: sammā dhammaṁ bhāvetvāna → mamopamaṁ karitvāna (bj, pts) | sammā dhammaṁ bhāvetvāna sīlāni → mamopamaṁ karitvāna silāni (sya-all) | karitvāna → sammā dhammaṁ bhāvetvā (bj: machasaṁ) | bhāvetvāna → mamopamaṁ karitvāna (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap25:26.4: saraṇo vandati → caraṇe vandāmi (sya-all) | caraṇe → saraṇo (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu); saraṇe (bj: PTS) | saraṇo → caraṇe (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap25:27.2: buddhassa gacchahaṁ → buddhamagañchahaṁ (sya-all); buddhass agañch ahaṁ (pts)
